versions.changelog:
Initial release of dapianke — a course design consultant based on the "好课像大片" (Blockbuster Course) methodology.

- Guides users through six key stages: positioning, framework, opening, middle, closing, and sales.
- Enables persistent, project-based tracking — saves progress and allows multi-session course polishing, with reusable results across lessons.
- Automatically loads prior outcomes as context to streamline iterative design and review.
- Triggered by keywords related to course design, curriculum development, training delivery, and course sales.
- Provides structured templates, self-check prompts, and actionable workflows for comprehensive course creation and improvement.

Initial release: Course design skill suite based on "好课像大片" methodology.                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  7 skills covering the full course design workflow:                                                                                                                                                                
  - course-00-overview: Overall guidance and self-assessment                                                                                                                                                        
  - course-01-positioning: Course positioning (钉子 = 一痛+一招+一不)
  - course-02-framework: Framework design (三极致+三标准)
  - course-03-opening: Opening design (塑造挑战三步法)
  - course-04-middle: Middle section design (先破后立)
  - course-05-closing: Closing design (实效教学法三阶段)
  - course-06-sales: Sales design (钉子营销三步法)

  Each stage outputs a deliverable that feeds into the next stage.
  Empathy and suspense methodologies embedded as references in relevant skills.
